description:
develop push CI at 4f8b72ea4 (run 43723309628, after fz-rgk made the limit CPU time) fails the coverage step on four tests, three of them from this epic, each "fz2 exceeded 20s of CPU":

- matrix::01254_a_long_body_copies_its_frame_forward_when_a_collection_kept_it::interp
- a_long_body_copies_its_frame_forward_when_a_collection_kept_it (the --log-telemetry test over the same fixture, tests/fixture_matrix.rs)
- matrix::01294_enum_filter_over_four_hundred_thousand_elements_does_not_overflow_the_stack::interp

Locally at opt-level 1, `fz2 interp` uses 3.1 s of CPU on 01254 and 3.5 s on 01294; the coverage build is about six times slower. Same class as fz-9x7.9 (fixture 01256).

Done when: the coverage step passes on develop for these tests.

comments.text: develop push CI at e81f9ed52 (run 43724531150) passes the coverage step: the fixture-matrix binary reports 3614 passed, 0 failed, against 3610 passed, 4 failed at 4f8b72ea4 (run 43723309628), so all four tests that exceeded 20 s of CPU there now fit. PR #633 (fz-sc8.227) cuts 01254/01294 instructions about 10% but leaves cycles flat (peer's measurement); the margin under the limit at e81f9ed52 is not measured.

title: Fixtures 01254 and 01294 fit the coverage job's 20 s CPU limit on the interpreter
